verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents a recurring nightly refresh for each data connection, and users can change the time it runs. It also rebuilds the Model overnight and lists 'Proactive alerts & triggers' as a plan feature. The only user-adjustable schedule is the nightly sync time, so there is no evidence of scheduling arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules for arbitrary workflows or Ari tasks (e.g. a weekly report or scheduled scenario runs), documentation of how triggers are configured, cadence options beyond the nightly sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
